headword: お{願|ねが}いいたします

definitions.gloss: please; thank you in advance; if you would (very polite)
definitions.explanation: A very polite request expression formed by combining the humble verb いたす with the noun {願|ねが}い (request). Used to politely ask for help, action, or continued goodwill. More formal than the everyday お{願|ねが}いします.

examples.japanese: ⟦よろしく→よろしく：01070_yoroshiku⟧お{願|ねが}いいたします。
examples.english: I look forward to working with you (very polite).

examples.japanese: ⟦ご{確認|かくにん}→ご確認：23544_gokakunin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ほどお{願|ねが}いいたします。
examples.english: I would appreciate your kind confirmation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今後|こんご}→今後：02808_kongo⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{変|か}わらぬ→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧お{引|ひ}き{立|た}て⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{賜|たまわ}ります→賜る：07659_tamawaru⟧よう、お{願|ねが}いいたします。
examples.english: I respectfully ask for your continued patronage.

notes:
Replaces ⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧ with the humble form ⟦いたします→いたす：01314_itasu⟧ to lift the politeness of お{願|ねが}いします a notch. Standard register for emails to clients, business letters, and formal customer service.

LEVELS OF "PLEASE":
- ⟦{頼|たの}む→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧: casual; among friends, between equals
- ⟦お{願|ねが}い→お願い：10299_onegai⟧: casual to neutral; everyday request
- お{願|ねが}いします: standard polite; ubiquitous
- お{願|ねが}いいたします: very polite; humble form, business and formal contexts
- ⟦お{願|ねが}い→お願い：10299_onegai⟧⟦{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます→申し上げる：01734_moushiageru⟧: extremely polite; ceremonial speeches and formal letters

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦よろしく→よろしく：01070_yoroshiku⟧お{願|ねが}いいたします: very polite "thank you in advance" / "nice to meet you"
- ⟦{何卒|なにとぞ}→何卒：19658_nanitozo⟧お{願|ねが}いいたします: "please, I humbly ask"
- ⟦ご{確認|かくにん}→ご確認：23544_gokakunin⟧お{願|ねが}いいたします: "please confirm" (in business email)

USAGE:
Very common as a closing line in business emails, often combined with ⟦{何卒|なにとぞ}→何卒：19658_nanitozo⟧ (please, kindly) for added formality.
